title: Viral Whole Genome Sequencing Using Illumina Microbial Amplicon Prep (iMAP)
author: Stepfan de Villiers
materials: In two microcentrifuge tubes, combine the following reagents to prepare a PCR 1 Master Mix and a PCR 2 Master Mix. The indicated volumes are per sample. Reagent PCR 1 Master Mix (μL) PCR 2 Master Mix (μL) 1 IPM 7.5 7.5 2 Nuclease free water 2.3 2.3 3 PP1 (10 µM) 2.2 - 4 PP2 (10 µM) - 2.2 5 Total 12 12 PCR Master Mixes
In a microcentrifuge tube, combine the following reagents to prepare the TagmentationMaster Mix. The indicated volume is per sample.
In a microcentrifuge tube, combine the following reagents to prepare the TAGPCR Master Mix :

steps.title: Prepare EPH3 Dilution
steps.instruction: Prepare a dilution of EPH3 for the number of samples in the run.

substeps.instruction: Combine 1.5 μL EPH3 and 3.0 μL nuclease-free water per sample (Total 4.5 μL).

steps.title: Prepare Primer Pools
steps.instruction: Assemble and dilute primer pools for the target viral pathogens (SARS-CoV-2, RSV, or Dengue).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend all primers from IDT in 0.1× TE buffer to a final concentration of 100 μM.
Assemble two overlapping pools by transferring 5 μL of each 100 μM primer from a specific pool into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and mixing thoroughly.
Prepare 10 μM working primer pools by combining 20 μL of the 100 μM primer pool with 180 μL of nuclease-free water (NFW).

steps.title: Anneal RNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the cDNA plate and perform the RNA annealing step.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 μL EPH3 dilution and 4 μL RNA to each well of a 96-well PCR plate labeled 'cDNA'.
Seal, vortex (1600 rpm, 1 minute), and centrifuge (500 x g, 1 minute).
Run the Anneal RNA program on a thermal cycler: 65°C for 3 minutes, then hold at 4°C.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize first strand cDNA using a master mix.

substeps.instruction: Prepare First Strand cDNA Master Mix by combining 4.5 μL FSM (First Strand Mix) and 0.5 μL RVT (Reverse Transcriptase) per sample (Total 5.0 μL).
Add 4 μL of this master mix to each well of the cDNA plate.
Seal, vortex (1600 rpm, 1 minute), and centrifuge (500 x g, 1 minute).
Run the FSS Program: 25°C for 5 minutes, 42°C for 30 minutes, 80°C for 5 minutes, then hold at 4°C.
Safe Stopping Point: Seal plate and store at -25°C to -15°C.

steps.title: Pathogen-Specific PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification using the cDNA templates.

substeps.instruction: Label two new PCR plates as 'PCR1' and 'PCR2'.
Add 10 μL PCR 1 Master Mix to the PCR1 plate and 10 μL PCR 2 Master Mix to the PCR2 plate.
Transfer 2.5 μL from the cDNA plate to the corresponding wells of both PCR1 and PCR2 plates.
Seal, vortex (1600 rpm, 1 minute), and centrifuge (500 x g, 1 minute).

Run the relevant PCR program (Preheat Lid: 105°C, Reaction Volume: 15 μL). For SARS-CoV-2: 98°C 3 min; 35 cycles of [98°C 15 sec, 64°C 5 min]; hold at 4°C. For RSV: reduce annealing temperature to 56°C.
Check at least 10% of samples using Qubit Fluorometer and Qubit DNA HS Assay.
Safe Stopping Point: Seal plate and store at 2°C to 8°C or leave on thermal cycler overnight.

steps.title: Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Perform tagmentation on the combined PCR products.

substeps.instruction: Label a new PCR plate 'TAG'.
Transfer 5 μL from each well of PCR1 and 5 μL from each well of PCR2 to the corresponding wells of the TAG plate.
Add 15 μL of the tagmentation master mix to each well.
Seal, vortex (1600 rpm, 1 minute), and centrifuge (500 x g, 1 minute).
Run the TAG program (Preheat Lid: 105°C, Reaction Volume: 25 μL).

steps.title: Post-Tagmentation Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean up the tagmented DNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Immediately add 5 μL ST2 (Stop Tagment Buffer 2) to each well of the TAG plate.
Seal, shake, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then centrifuge briefly.
Place on a magnetic stand until the liquid is clear and discard the supernatant.
Wash beads: Add 50 μL TWB (Tagmentation Wash Buffer), seal, vortex (1600 rpm, 1 minute), centrifuge (500 x g, 1 minute), place on magnetic stand until clear, and discard supernatant.
Repeat the wash step a second time, but leave the supernatant in the plate after the second wash to prevent overdrying.
With the plate on the magnetic stand, remove the supernatant and use a P20 pipette to remove any remaining TWB.

steps.title: TAG PCR and Indexing
steps.instruction: Amplify the tagmented DNA and add index adapters.

substeps.instruction: Remove TAG plate from magnetic stand.
Add 20 μL TAG PCR Master Mix and 5 μL Index Adapters to each well.
Seal, vortex (1600 rpm, 1 minute), and centrifuge (500 x g, 1 minute).

Run the TAG PCR Program (Preheat Lid: 100°C, Reaction Volume: 25 μL): 72°C 3 min, 98°C 3 min, then cycles of [98°C 20 sec, 60°C 30 sec, 72°C 1 min] for 7-12 cycles depending on cDNA input (1-24ng: 12 cycles; 25-99ng: 9 cycles; 100-500ng: 7 cycles), then 72°C 3 min, hold at 10°C.

steps.title: Final Library Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the final library using Illumina Purification Beads (IPB).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge TAG plate at 500 x g for 1 minute, then place on magnetic stand for 3 minutes until clear.
Label a new plate 'IPB'. Add 22.5 μL IPB to each well.
Transfer 25 μL supernatant from the TAG plate to the IPB plate, vortex, and centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes until clear and discard supernatant.
Wash beads: Add 100 μL 80% EtOH, wait 30 seconds, then discard supernatant. Repeat wash a second time.
Centrifuge briefly to collect remaining EtOH, place on magnetic stand, and use a P20 pipette to remove ALL residual EtOH.
Air-dry on magnetic stand for 1 minute.
Add 21 μL RSB (Resuspension Buffer) to resuspend beads, vortex, centrifuge briefly, and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place on magnetic rack for 3 minutes until clear.
Transfer 20 μL of supernatant to a new PCR plate labeled 'LIB'.
Safe Stopping Point: Seal plate and store at -25°C to -15°C.

steps.title: Library Quantification and Sequencing Prep
steps.instruction: Quantify, normalize, and pool libraries for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Analyze 1 μL of each library using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay.
Calculate molarity using 350 bp as the average library size.
Dilute each library to 4 nM using RSB.
Pool 5 μL from each library into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Quantify the pool using the Takara Library Quantification Kit (qPCR).
Optional: Run 1 μL of the pool on a TapeStation (D1000 ScreenTape) to confirm size.
Dilute the library to the starting concentration for the chosen platform (e.g., NextSeq: 2 nM, MiSeq V2: 4 nM) and follow manufacturer's denature and dilute instructions.
